reason: Reduce wall-clock time after explicit author approval while preserving all case-level experimental conditions.
invariants: The frozen runner, protocol, prompt, Skill, model, provider, reasoning effort, container, inputs, and acceptance checks remain unchanged.
Every case still receives at most one Codex agent invocation.
Additional workers use the frozen runner's existing --case-id interface.
Worker assignments are disjoint and target only cases pending at the amendment boundary.
No retry is permitted for an accepted, rejected, interrupted, or failed invocation.
Concurrency changes wall-clock scheduling only and is not treated as a method change.

primary_existing_process.policy: Continue the original manifest-order execute command; cases already claimed by an additional worker are refused by the frozen exact-once guard.

failure_policy.ordinary_rejected_candidate: Record the terminal result and continue.
failure_policy.systemic_failure: Create the shared parallel stop marker, stop starting new assigned cases, preserve all terminal and in-flight artifacts, and stop the other launchers as soon as the monitor observes the marker.
failure_policy.already_in_flight_at_detection: Do not retry; retain its terminal outcome.

evidence_policy: All case-level outputs remain in the canonical run directory; the final verifier and blind adjudication bind to this run only.
